title: Use case diagram — effective application permissions
subtitle: System boundary: SiteTrace / MCPA · all actors authenticate with an active company profile
notes: All roles: authenticate/recover password; Settings/theme/logout. Equipment roles: own notices where permitted.
* Engineer/Architect interruptions require installed cancellation gateway, exact ownership/state and server allowedActions.
Tool Handler equipment UI is read-only; base DB metadata privileges are broader. Admin is not a named-receiver substitute.

title: Authentication and company-profile verification
subtitle: Actor is shown in each activity · decisions rechecked server-side · one asset record moves as a whole
notes: Invite/recovery callback uses valid session → password setup (minimum 12 characters) → save → sign out.
Backend identity/RLS independently rechecks active authorization on protected operations.

title: Equipment registration and Office default
subtitle: Actor is shown in each activity · decisions rechecked server-side · one asset record moves as a whole
notes: No photo selected follows the main path; selected image must be JPEG/PNG/WebP with matching signature.
Office default is prospective; no historical equipment location correction is part of registration.

title: Equipment request, approval and release
subtitle: Actor is shown in each activity · decisions rechecked server-side · one asset record moves as a whole
notes: * Optional cancellation gateway: requester may withdraw Pending or cancel Approved/unreleased with reason.
Approval reserves; release creates a handover. Physical custody changes only after committed inspection/receipt.

title: QR transfer and named-receiver confirmation
subtitle: Actor is shown in each activity · decisions rechecked server-side · one asset record moves as a whole
notes: Receiving QR expires in 15 minutes; token hash stored privately; resolving a QR does not transfer custody.
* Refused handover keeps equipment/custody and reservation; eligible original field sender reopens/cancels.

title: Office return and inspected receiving
subtitle: Actor is shown in each activity · decisions rechecked server-side · one asset record moves as a whole
notes: Good/damaged branches represent physically returned records; Office wrapper clears damaged-return holder.
Missing records do not physically arrive at Office. All outcome branches commit within the same return transaction.

title: Repair reporting and Admin resolution
subtitle: Actor is shown in each activity · decisions rechecked server-side · one asset record moves as a whole
notes: Receipt/return/recovery of damaged equipment can create a repair report through linked inspection outcomes.
No verified preventive schedule, technician/cost ledger or repair-photo work-order form is implied.

title: Missing reporting and recovery
subtitle: Actor is shown in each activity · decisions rechecked server-side · one asset record moves as a whole
notes: The main path through repair creation applies only to damaged recovery; good recovery skips that activity.
Physical recovery is recorded by Admin; field users do not receive a recovery action.

title: Consumable requests, stock receipts and ledger
subtitle: Actor is shown in each activity · decisions rechecked server-side · one asset record moves as a whole
notes: Purchases ledger is separate: saving it never increments stock. Material requests have no approval stage.
Non-cancellation path proceeds to optional independent ledger recording; no ledger entry is required to receive stock.

title: System architecture and data movement
subtitle: Static browser application with managed Supabase services · no custom application server
notes: Pages settings, live policies, external scheduler, Auth/email/Storage/Realtime installation: NEEDS VERIFICATION.

title: ERD 1 / 4 — identity, projects and equipment
subtitle: Solid: declared FK (parent 1 → child many; labels give nullability) · dashed: association, FK unverified
notes: Auth linkage and equipment reservation are at most one per parent; nullable/unique fields are labeled.

title: ERD 2 / 4 — movements, allocation and interruption audit
subtitle: All solid connectors are declared foreign keys · *_id labels identify the child column
notes: Cancellation/refusal actor FKs are named in their boxes to keep the view readable; see full FK catalog for every edge.

title: ERD 3 / 4 — consumable stock and procurement
subtitle: Solid: declared foreign key · purchase ledger records never increment consumable stock
notes: Receipt and image paths are semantic Storage references, not declared FKs. Stock receipts use request and item row locks.

title: ERD 4 / 4 — account jobs, notifications and receiving context
subtitle: Solid parent-to-child connectors: repository-declared FKs · managed Storage schema omitted
notes: * Notification entity_id is a semantic text reference without a declared FK. Unique profile FKs are at most one.
Private return_office configuration is in ERD 1; immutable cancellation/refusal audit is in ERD 2.
